items.title: Impax Asset Management expands listed equities team with two appointments
items.summary: Impax Asset Management has appointed Sebastien Bidault and Paul Byrne to its listed equities team.

items.title: FCA warns public over LW Management Clone firm
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has issued a warning regarding an unauthorised clone firm operating under the name LW Management.

items.title: MS Amlin launches AI-powered tool to speed up policy wordings
items.summary: Lloyd’s carrier MS Amlin is introducing an artificial intelligence tool designed to reduce contract review times for renewals.

items.title: FCA secures High Court order to stop HTX crypto promotions
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has obtained a High Court order preventing global crypto exchange HTX from promoting services to UK consumers.

items.title: Lloyds executive criticises chancellor over linking bank tax rises to energy support
items.summary: William Chalmers has warned the government against extending the higher bank levy beyond March 2028 and questioned tying bank taxes to household energy bills.

items.title: PASA launches career development toolkit for pensions administration
items.summary: The Pensions Administration Standards Association has released a new resource aimed at supporting growth across pensions administration careers.
